# Sebastian Inman

> Senior Enterprise Web Systems Engineer specializing in design systems, TypeScript monorepos, and accessibility engineering. Founder of BetterA11y, an independent WCAG-based web and document accessibility auditing and remediation practice.

Sebastian is a senior software engineer based in Talent, Oregon, open to remote, hybrid, and on-site roles. His background spans enterprise frontend architecture, design systems, component libraries, and TypeScript-first tooling for multi-brand organizations.

## Experience

- Founder & Principal Accessibility Consultant, BetterA11y, Talent, OR (Jan 2026 – Present): Developed custom tools and processes for auditing, reporting, and remediating accessibility issues across 8 modules (document and page structure, headings and lists, image alt text, table headers, form fields, contrast and legibility, readability, and scanned documents).
- Senior Software Developer, NIC Industries, Inc., White City, OR (Aug 2024 – Nov 2025): Led architectural redesign and modernization of digital properties across three consumer-facing brands (NIC Industries, Prismatic Powders, and Cerakote), including a fully typed monorepo of 10 shared packages and a unified design system with accessible React component libraries.
- Senior Web Developer, Juggernaut Marketing and Consulting, Medford, OR (Jul 2021 – Jun 2023): Independently owned the full web design and development lifecycle, as sole developer, for 10+ clients, using React, JavaScript, PHP, and Node.js.
- Frontend Web Developer, NIC Industries, Inc., White City, OR (Jan 2020 – Jul 2021): Built reusable Vue.js components and data-driven UI patterns.
- Senior Full Stack Developer, Highway Products Inc., White City, OR (Jan 2013 – Jan 2020): Independently owned web development, as sole developer, for Highway Products and two subsidiaries, Pavati Marine and Pavati Wake.

## Core Competencies

- Languages & Frameworks: TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Vue.js, Node.js, PHP
- Architecture & Systems: Design Systems, Component Libraries, Monorepo Architecture
- Accessibility & Performance: WCAG Auditing & Remediation, Document Accessibility, Performance Optimization
- Web Fundamentals: HTML5, CSS3, Sass
- Data & Integration: MySQL, REST API Integration
- Tooling & DevOps: Docker, CI/CD & Build Pipelines, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop
